title: Comfortable UI sizing — ONE library-wide --ui-scale comfort scalar; the dock/dropdown scales re-homed as specializations; coarse-pointer amplification global
headline: Mint --ui-scale (@property <number>, inherits:true, default identity 1) as the ONE master comfortable-sizing scalar every interactive-control magnitude (height, padding, gap, font, glyph) derives through calc(<base> * var(--ui-scale)); re-home the already-shipped --dock-scale (W45) as calc(var(--ui-scale) * var(--dock-local-scale, 1)) so the dock is a specialization ON the global axis (ONE scale system, not three); lift the coarse-pointer 1.5x to the GLOBAL :root so the WHOLE library grows in lockstep on touch; the WCAG-2.5.5 44px floor survives as a max(scaled, --control-floor) clamp; the phi-display ladder stays EXCLUDED (a hero is not a touch target).

liveRediagnosis.ritual: AX.W00 wave-open — source-level re-diagnosis confirmed at HEAD before any edit

fiveRedWitnessesConfirmedAtHead.evidence: git show HEAD:src/styles/tokens.css | grep -c ui-scale = 0. The only size-scale token is the dock-local --dock-scale (a specialization with no master).

fiveRedWitnessesConfirmedAtHead.witness: RED 2 — control heights are buried raw h-* literals
fiveRedWitnessesConfirmedAtHead.evidence: button/index.ts (h-10/h-7/h-9/h-11), toggle/index.ts (h-10/h-9/h-11), avatar (h-10), select (h-9/h-10), combobox (h-10), command (h-11), number-field (h-10), tabs (h-10), toast (h-8), glass.css .input-pill height:2.5rem — 0 reading a scale axis.

fiveRedWitnessesConfirmedAtHead.witness: RED 3 — control fonts are buried raw text-sm/text-xs literals
fiveRedWitnessesConfirmedAtHead.evidence: button/toggle base text-sm, badge size rungs text-xs/text-sm/text-base, alert text-sm, glass.css .btn-pill/.input-pill font-size:1rem — the static --type-* phi-ladder read directly, no comfort multiplier.

fiveRedWitnessesConfirmedAtHead.witness: RED 4 — glyphs are buried raw size-* literals
fiveRedWitnessesConfirmedAtHead.evidence: button/toggle size-4, badge size-3.5, alert [&>svg]:size-4. Only the dock glyph scales (--dock-icon-glyph reads --dock-scale, NOT a global axis), so a library-wide bump breaks the box-glyph proportion.

--dock-scale: 1 (coarse 1.5) is a complete local axis reading NO global master; W50's --dropdown-text would be a second; the rest of the library a third (un-scaled). A coarse bump the dock honors the buttons/inputs/badges do NOT — inconsistent touch scaling.

folds.gestaltFix: ADD --ui-scale (@property { syntax:<number>; inherits:true; initial-value:1 } mirroring the W54 --glass-level idiom) + :root default 1 + --ui-coarse-scale 1.5, with the scale-system doctrine recorded in a tokens.css section comment (ONE scalar; dock/dropdown specialize; phi-display ladder excluded).

Mint --control-h-{xs,sm,md,lg} = max(calc(<base> * var(--ui-scale)), var(--control-floor)) (28/36/40/44px register, the WCAG-44px coarse clamp baked in); re-point every CVA size rung + the .input-pill height onto them.

Mint --control-text = calc(var(--type-small) * var(--ui-scale)) + --control-text-sm = calc(var(--type-caption) * var(--ui-scale)); re-point the button/toggle/badge/alert base fonts + the .btn-pill/.input-pill font onto them. The phi-DISPLAY ladder stays a pure typographic scale (display headings do NOT grow on touch).
folds.evidence: tokens.css register + the 4 CVA bases + glass.css pills

folds.gestaltFix: Mint --ui-glyph = calc(1rem * var(--ui-scale)) + --ui-glyph-sm = calc(0.875rem * var(--ui-scale)); re-point the un-sized-<svg> CVA rule onto size-[var(--ui-glyph)], KEEPING the :not([class*=size-]) host-sized-icon escape intact.

Re-home --dock-scale: calc(var(--ui-scale) * var(--dock-local-scale, 1)) — a ONE-line scalar-definition edit that cascades the global axis through W45's existing 150-line dock geometry calc chain for FREE (zero edit to the density cascade). The dock coarse block (dock/overflow.css) re-expresses to set --dock-local-scale: var(--dock-mobile-scale, 1) (the stack-extra) so the dock inherits the GLOBAL coarse 1.5x, NOT a parallel hardcoded 1.5 (no double-scale). --dock-mobile-scale default flipped 1.5 -> 1 (the optional stack-extra default).
folds.evidence: tokens.css --dock-scale definition + dock/overflow.css coarse block; dock/density.css UNTOUCHED (reads the re-homed scalar)

folds.gestaltFix: Add @media (pointer: coarse) { :root { --ui-scale: var(--ui-coarse-scale, 1.5); --control-floor: var(--touch-target, 2.75rem) } } so the WHOLE library grows ~1.5x on touch from ONE place + the WCAG-44px floor clamp engages.
folds.evidence: tokens.css global coarse block after the main :root close
